subject.title: [Feature]: Webhook hook sessions should reuse existing session when sessionKey is consistent (multi-turn support)

question: Should OpenClaw accept explicit persistent `/hooks/agent` sessions for trusted hooks, and what security gates must be required before PR #75918 can land?
rationale: The requested behavior changes a core hook API/config surface and can expose prior session context across webhook deliveries, so automation should not choose the permanent product/security boundary alone.

options.title: Land explicit persistent mode
options.body: Accept `sessionMode: "persistent"` as an opt-in trusted-hook path while keeping existing isolated behavior as the default.

options.title: Keep hooks isolated
options.body: Reject persistent hook sessions for now and update docs to make isolated one-shot behavior explicit.

options.title: Choose another API shape
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask the PR to use a different maintainer-approved field or mapping contract before implementation proceeds.

recommendation.title: Land explicit persistent mode
recommendation.body: Accept `sessionMode: "persistent"` as an opt-in trusted-hook path while keeping existing isolated behavior as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best available decision owner from the issue review and recent hook/session/security-boundary history.
